effects.notes: Each time the owner plows field tiles: gain 1 sheep per field tile just plowed (fields_gained_this_event, A105 precedent; after_field_gained vocabulary covers 耕作).

unresolved_fields: effects.0: the card triggers on '畑を耕すたびに' (each time you plow), while after_field_gained fires for all field gains including non-plow gains (A105 notes 'Covers all ways of gaining new field tiles'); whether field tiles gained without plowing (e.g., A019 take_field_from_round_space) should trigger the effect is not stated by the source
review.notes: Plowing: 1 sheep per field tile plowed; after_field_gained covers gained/plowed fields per the vocabulary, and fields_gained_this_event is the A105 count source.
